# F-03: the GHA corpus (docs/ci.md Appendix F)

`starter-workflows/` is every workflow of [actions/starter-workflows](https://github.com/actions/starter-workflows)
at `e3c451d60f119b71caebf13c98ac45da6e15b4b7` (MIT). The rest are up to 15 workflows from each
